title: Diamond Head by Cecily Wong
description:
Diamond Head by Cecily Wong

Novels and Nibbles follows the wealthy Leong family from China to Hawaii, where the murder of their patriarch sets off generations of secrets, heartbreak, and loss. Told through the family’s women, the story centers on eighteen-year-old Theresa, whose pregnancy forces her to confront the family’s tangled past. Woven around the Chinese legend of the red string of fate, this novel explores love, sacrifice, and whether we can break free from the mistakes of those who came before us. Ooh. Intriguing! Legends, death, and secrets, this sounds like a good one!

This book screams Spicy Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl which is why we are having it this week! Marinated Ahi tuna finds its destiny upon a snowy bed of sushi rice. Shredded carrots and green onions weave bright ribbons through the bowl, while avocado and cucumber bring the cool hush of a jade garden. Crispy Sriracha edamame carries the dragon’s fire, and a swirl of Sriracha mayo binds flavors together and readies them to be devoured because this dish is just that tasty.

This poke bowl is a smidge of heat, a little harmony, and a happily ever after in every bite!

$16.95
